title: MH370 full-domain CMEMS ocean-drift admission surface

query_contract.algorithm: nearest source cell by great-circle distance

out_of_support.required_behavior: error; do not extrapolate and do not treat as zero or neutral current

query_contract.admission_rule: Only admissible_conditional_likelihood families may update the integrated estimator.

families.label: Full-domain GLORYS12 currents + distinct WAVERYS Stokes
families.role: time-varying assimilative-current family with distinct wave Stokes sensitivity
conditions: GLORYS12V1 daily native 1/12-degree surface currents from 0E-180E and 55S-15N over 2014-03-07 through 2017-01-31
WAVERYS three-hourly 0.2-degree surface Stokes velocity is a distinct field with an explicit one-times response; direct windage remains separate

the same nine stringent recovery episodes, two Australian non-recovery populations, object-response laws, seed, proposal accounting, and conservative arrival-conditional isotope screen are used as the matched family comparison
the source-cell prior is removed before the conditional likelihood is exposed
limitations: GLORYS12V1 assimilates ocean observations; the drifter replay is not guaranteed statistically held out
WAVERYS assimilates significant wave height and uses GLORYS12 currents in its wave calculation
one-times surface Stokes response, object leeway, diffusivity, recovery kernels, and beaching-to-discovery delays are sensitivities rather than jointly out-of-sample calibrated parameters
the persistent GLORYS12/WAVERYS support-mask union distinguishes land encounter but is not a measured shoreline or calibrated beaching, retention, or refloating model
this family remains separate from native HYCOM and GDP; no subjective family weight or pooled surface is reported

checks.name: complete_evidence_scope
checks.explanation: Every selected recovery and Australian non-recovery population must be represented.

checks.name: out_of_support_termination
checks.explanation: Missing, outside-spatial, and outside-time support are failures, never zero current.

checks.name: eventwise_arrival_ess
checks.explanation: Supported source mass must have hundreds-scale effective arrivals for every recovery.

checks.name: seed_and_particle_stability
checks.explanation: The exact surface must be stable when the seed changes and particle count doubles.

checks.name: predictive_drifter_validation
checks.explanation: All attempts, including terminated paths, are scored against persistence.

checks.name: conservative_isotope_screen
checks.explanation: Isotope is conditional on represented Reunion arrival and may only downweight.
